integrity: The displayed identities hold for all positive integral run lengths and factor lengths; finite executable tests are not proof of the infinite statements. Scholarly originality is assessed relative to the inspected sources and may be revised if equivalent work is found.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula covers periodic binary words with one positive run of each symbol, not arbitrary periodic words. It has been proved by elementary first-return analysis and tested finitely, but not independently audited; possible unindexed prior equivalents remain.
title: Exact closed and open factor complexity of \((0^a1^b)^\omega\)
